title: Numerical simulation of explosions inside aircraft tanks
author: Rafael Guimbra Dias Neves
abstract: Inside aircraft tanks, the kerosene mixture evaporates while fuel is consumed. The process may form an explosive mixture when it is in contact with a heat source, like an unexpected spark. In the present study, the combustion development is modelled by a deflagration process, in which compressible effects are not considered. Turbulence drastically influences the way combustion develops and must be taken into account. A previous study with laminar hypothesis had already been made. The main objective of this work is to continue this study and analyse the pressure development inside aircraft tanks when turbulent effects are considered. Different geometries are studied.
